verdict.reason: The source reports excavators' own estimates ("eens per tien meldingen" up to more than one deviation per report), but only as signals from excavators, and warns that they may count deviations under 1 m that are not formal deviations. It also says the "ten years on" problem concerns deviations being reported poorly, and that reports of them are very rare. The claim states the frequency as a finding and omits this caveat.
